statement: The shell is thick enough to print airtight: it is nowhere thinner than four perimeters, 1.8 mm
rationale: Prusa's water tests on printed cylinders found four perimeters the minimum for PLA and PETG to hold water (input fdm-whistle-printing-notes, section 3). Four lines of 0.45 mm are 1.8 mm. A wall this thick CAN be printed airtight; that a print IS airtight is seen when it speaks (C24). The labium tip and the rims of the openings are thinner on purpose and are not shell.

mechanism.how: The thinnest section of the shell as designed (the smaller of the shell wall and the chamber floor), and the thinnest shell wall model/mesh.py measured on the print file before the voicing cuts, each held to the limit.
